name: Acceptor Currency Conversion Response V 13
definition: The AcceptorCurrencyConversionResponse message is sent by currency conversion service provider to the card acceptor to return the result of a potential currency conversion for the cardholder.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Currency conversion response message management information.

CurrencyConversionResponse.name: Currency Conversion Response
CurrencyConversionResponse.definition: Information related to the outcome of the currency conversion.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC (message authentication code).
